Name: Tibs Tractor Skins
Author: noitibmar
Description:
Add new tractor skins that feel a bit more 3D than the default one. This is my first Stardew Mod so please let me know everything I've done wrong x
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/hVfZx21.gif[/img][/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/IcLJnvI.png[/img][/center]
1 - Make sure you have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401/]TractorMod[/url] installed
1.5 - Optionally install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to access settings while in game
2 - Download the Zip file and extract into your Mods folder
3 - Run your game through SMAPI

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/89zgGTk.png[/img]﻿[/center]
This mod uses Content Patcher so there's no need to manually copy/paste files into your Tractor Mod.
Simply unzip into your Mods folder and select the Tractor you want in GenericModConfigMenu or by editing the config.json file created after you run the game with the mod once.
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/rN5WPGn.gif[/img]    [img]https://i.imgur.com/Iyc902Y.gif[/img][/center]I'd love to expand this mod to have more colours and other tractor styles in future, so let me know what you would like to see and if you're able to...
